messages:
noah: tiny brainteaser for the lunch crowd — if our small internal model were a stand-up comedian, what would its persona be? pick absurd options :laughing:

rita: "The Espresso Comedian"  fast, jittery, delivers one-liners about latency.

marco: "Dry Documentation Dad"  deadpan takes on README jokes.

lila: "Overly Polite Bot"  apologizes before every punchline.

noah: starting poll in 1m. please vote. also if you want to test, here's the tiny prompt I used:
```
System: You are an "Espresso Comedian"  fast-talking, coffee metaphors, loves puns about timeouts.
User: Say a one-liner about kernels and espresso.
```

bot-ops: poll created by noah: Espresso Comedian, Dry Documentation Dad, Overly Polite Bot. Voting open 12h.

rita: ran it on toybox-mini: "I drink espresso so my kernels wake up on time." :coffee: :rofl:

marco: hah, saving that. can we make a tiny archive of the best one-liners for the lunch thread?

lila: yes pls. add a short note: none of these are real person imitates and tag as meme/satire.

bot-ops: poll closed. Results: Espresso Comedian 60%, Overly Polite Bot 25%, Dry Documentation Dad 15%.

noah: winner! drop your top 2 one-liners below. low-effort fun only.

rita: "Our latency is a feature  it builds dramatic tension."

marco: "This espresso is single-origin, unlike my stateful kernels." :coffee:

lila: "Sorry, did that joke offend your feelings? I will buffer and retry." :blush:
